step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture shows two main AWS environments: AWS Data on the left and AWS User Experience/Processing on the right, connected via VPC Peering. On the left side, data flows from S3 to EKS, and then through VPC Peering to the EKS cluster in the User/Processing account. On the right side, an external User uploads data directly to S3. S3 triggers an event to SQS. SQS connects to EKS, ASG (Auto Scaling Group), and back to S3 for processed data outputs.
